title: Customer Ramp Blueprint: Staged Enablement & Signal Contract for Beta Cohorts
creator: Aarav Patel
description: Create a repeatable, stage-gated playbook for ramping customers through tiered beta cohorts. The playbook will coordinate release notes, enablement tasks, feedback loops, and acceptance signals so Engineering, Design, Sales, and CS can run 3 consecutive cohort waves with measurable quality and adoption KPIs.
objectives: Define 3 cohort gates with clear entry/exit criteria (alpha-internal, beta-wave-1, beta-wave-2)
Standardize a signal contract (telemetry + qualitative feedback) each cohort must satisfy before expansion
Align release notes cadence and artifact ownership across teams
Reduce time-to-first-success for new customers to <5 days during beta
success_criteria: At least 80% of Wave-1 customers reach activation milestone within 7 days
No P0 reliability regressions attributable to the release during Wave-1
Customer NPS qualitative signals average >= 7/10 in exit interviews for Wave-1
Feedback triage coverage: 90% of unique issues ack'd in SLO-aligned timeframes
rollout_phases: Phase 0: Internal dry-run (3 internal teams) — validate install/onboarding script and release note drafts
Phase 1: Wave-1 (10 external customers) — close monitoring, daily syncs, focused bugfix window
Phase 2: Wave-2 (25 customers) — expanded documentation, enablement kits, and automated telemetry checks
Phase 3: General availability prep — finalize release notes, escalate unresolved issues, handoff to GTM
responsibilities: PM (Sofia): program lead, acceptance gate decisions, stakeholder comms
Eng (Lead ENG): rollout stability, hotfix cadence, telemetry hooks
Design (Lead DES): onboarding flows, sample prompts, UX feedback synthesis
Support/CS: enablement sessions, onboarding playbooks, structured interviews
Docs: publish pre-release release notes + known-limitations section
release_notes_todo: Create pre-release changelog draft and publish internal FAQ for Sales
Add 'Known limitations & mitigation' section with temporary workarounds
Publish short enablement summary for executives and customer success managers
Link to telemetry dashboards and incident runbook in notes
feedback_collection_plan: Automated telemetry: adoption funnel events, latency P95, error-rate by route
Structured interviews: 30-minute exit interview script for Wave-1 & Wave-2
In-app feedback widget localized to cohort customers
Centralized feedback board (Drive/Sheets) with triage tags and SLA columns
kpis: Mean time to acknowledge customer-reported issues
Rolling 7-day token cost variance for cohort customers
Feature usage depth (number of distinct endpoints used per customer)
risk_mitigation: Pre-signed rollback plan (ENG) and explicit fallback model set for critical paths
Limit Wave-1 concurrent sessions per customer to cap burst load
Hotline: direct Slack channel + on-call pager rotation for first 72 hours
Freeze non-essential changes to runtime and infra during each wave
acceptance_gates: Gate A (Internal dry-run): all onboarding scripts validated and 1 critical path demo passed
Gate B (Wave-1 -> Wave-2): SLOs hold for 72h and top-10 customer pain points triaged
Gate C (Wave-2 -> GA prep): Documentation complete, release notes finalized, and exec sign-off obtained
